mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.parent_id, p.code, p.name, p.type, p.path, p.icon, p.sort_order FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_order
